title: WWE Survivor Series
sources: own knowledge of the game (written in our own words)

widgets.text:
Health, momentum
Natsume's 2004 WWE wrestler game: health and momentum meters for each wrestler

Grapples, strikes, finisher
Grapples, strikes, running attacks; finishers need a full momentum meter
Each wrestler has a signature move and a finisher
Roster on the select screen: Raw - Benoit, Triple H, Michaels, Kane, Edge, Jericho, Christian, Orton; SmackDown! - Eddie Guerrero, Undertaker, Kurt Angle, Booker T, RVD, Cena, Rey Mysterio, Chavo Guerrero

Reversals at the right time
Reverse grapples with the right timing; pin after a finisher, not before

rows: last wrestler standing wins (the Survivor Series format)

widgets.text:
Story and exhibition
Story mode and exhibition matches: singles, tag and elimination

Move set per wrestler
Move sets per wrestler; customise in the options when available

Wrestlers
Wrestlers and arenas unlocked through story mode
Unlock wrestlers and arenas by winning story matches

Story matches
Story matches won
Story matches won; elimination matches end the story
